message.content: The image shows a living room with white walls and a light-colored wood floor. The room is furnished with two red couches, each with two striped pillows, and a matching armchair. A small wooden table sits between the couches, and a white rug covers the floor. In the background, a doorway leads to another room, and a window on the right side of the room allows natural light to enter. The overall atmosphere of the room is cozy and inviting, with a sense of warmth and comfort.
